main_text.p: giam hîc concurrere confitendum eft, ac vanas effe obfervantias tales, effe-ctufque fraude diabolicâ inducî; vel fanguinis beneficio non folam virtutem medicamenti ad partem affectam deferri; fed & aliorum corporum virtutes eodem per eandem fanguinis proprietatem poffe ac debere deduci. At cur ergo non contingit, ut, dum dolor vulneris mitigatur vi fanguinis ipfi medicamento admixti, exafperetur interim dolor in vulnere, vi fangui-nis alterius in terram effufi, velcum linteis forte in ignem conjecti? Et, fi ea prae aliis corporibus omnibus eft Vitrioli proprietas, virtute Aftrorum huic foli impreffa; qui fit, quod illa virtus Aftrorum, primaria fcilicet mitigatrix dolorum atque vulnerum curatrix, quae à caelo ad centrum terrae dimanat, quoquoverfum diffufa, quaeque adeo Sanguinis directorio in partem affectam non indiget, unde fcilicet ipfa illa caeli feu Aftrorum progenies

page.notes: Catchword "genies" printed at the foot right; signature "G 5" at the foot left. Some letters in the scan are damaged; the reading "fcilicet" and "dimanat" are as printed in the scan.
